tools.name: check_and_book_appointment
tools.description: Check if a time slot is available on the doctor's calendar and book it if free. If the slot is taken, this tool will return the next available time. Always call this tool before confirming any appointment to the patient.

patient_name.description: Patient's full name as spoken on the call

patient_phone.description: Patient's phone number with country code, e.g. +919876543210

requested_date.description: Desired appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-09-15

requested_time.description: Desired appointment time in HH:MM 24-hour IST format, e.g. 11:00 or 14:30

cases.booked: Read message_to_speak to the patient. Then ask payment preference.
cases.suggest_new_slot: Read message_to_speak to the patient. If they agree, call this tool again with suggested_date and suggested_time.
cases.no_slots: Read message_to_speak. Ask if they want to book for tomorrow.

tools.name: send_confirmation
tools.description: Send booking confirmation to the patient via WhatsApp and SMS. Call this ONLY after the appointment is successfully booked (status=booked) and the patient has confirmed their payment preference.

patient_phone.description: Patient's phone number with country code

confirmed_date.description: Confirmed appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format

confirmed_time.description: Confirmed appointment time in HH:MM format

payment_mode.description: How the patient wants to pay. Use 'upi' if they chose online payment, 'pay_at_clinic' otherwise.

response_handling.notes: After this tool responds, read message_to_speak to the patient and end the call gracefully.

_setup_instructions.step1: Import and activate both n8n workflows (workflow-a and workflow-b)
_setup_instructions.step2: Copy Workflow A's webhook URL → paste into tools[0].url above
_setup_instructions.step3: Copy Workflow B's webhook URL → paste into tools[1].url above
_setup_instructions.step4: In Tough Tongue AI dashboard → your scenario → Custom Tools → paste each tool's JSON config
_setup_instructions.step5: Test by running a sample call and checking n8n execution logs
